list.title: Output styles
list.subtitle: Alternate response modes (concise, teaching, review…). Custom styles live under `.claude/output-styles/` and are selected via `outputStyle` in `settings.json` or `settings.local.json`.
list.builtInHelp: Built-in styles ship with Claude Code and aren't stored on disk — switch to a custom one to edit it here, or use Claude Code's `/config` command to swap.
list.noActiveHelp: No `outputStyle` set in `settings.json` / `settings.local.json` — Claude Code uses its `Default` style.

empty.title: No custom output styles
empty.description: Create one to add a teaching mode, a strict reviewer mode, a concise mode for quick lookups — anything that adapts how Claude responds without changing what it can do.

editor.descriptionHelp: Shown to the user in Claude Code's `/config` picker.
editor.keepCodingHelp: By default, custom output styles drop Claude Code's default coding instructions. Enable this to keep them alongside your additions (recommended for code-related styles).
